note: νμ CC-inclusive interaction rate/cross section on carbon (polystyrene, C8H8), extracted from muon kinematics fit to SciBar+MRD-stopped+MRD-penetrated samples in the Fermilab Booster Neutrino Beam (mean Eν≈0.8 GeV); reported both as an energy-dependent (6-bin, quasi-differential) flux-averaged cross section and as a single flux(Eν>0.25 GeV)-integrated total cross section, each separately extracted using NEUT and NUANCE MC-based efficiency/purity predictions. Target: per nucleon (on polystyrene C8H8 → treated as CH per nubib convention: per-nucleon on scintillator tags as CH, never C8H8). No covariance is published (per-bin total uncertainty only).
